## Purpose

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Safety and privacy impact

Describe any effect on routing eligibility, authorization, call safety, callback handling, target identity, privacy, or logging. State explicitly if there is no change.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `bash tools/test-all.sh`.
- [ ] I ran the Android build, unit tests, and lint where an Android SDK was available, or stated why that check was unavailable.
- [ ] I updated deterministic tests for changed policy or service behavior.
- [ ] I updated documentation where configuration, safety, privacy, or verification scope changed.
- [ ] I reviewed the staged diff and did not add credentials, real device identifiers, call data, screenshots, captures, logs, APKs, or signing material.

## Limitations

List the platform versions, hardware conditions, or real-device behaviors that remain unverified.
